statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the dialog identifier in the 2xx response matches the dialog identifier of an existing dialog, the dialog MUST be transitioned to the "confirmed" state, and the route set for the dialog MUST be recomputed based on the 2xx response using the procedures of Section 12.2.1.2.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the dialog identifier in the 2xx response matches the dialog identifier of an existing dialog, the dialog MUST be transitioned to the "confirmed" state, and the route set for the dialog MUST be recomputed based on the 2xx response using the procedures of Section 12.2.1.2.
actions: recompute route set based on 2xx response using procedures of Section 12.2.1.2

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Otherwise, a new dialog in the "confirmed" state MUST be constructed using the procedures of Section 12.1.2.
actions: construct new dialog in confirmed state using procedures of Section 12.1.2

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The UAC core MUST generate an ACK request for each 2xx received from the transaction layer.
actions: generate ACK request for each 2xx received from transaction layer

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The sequence number of the CSeq header field MUST be the same as the INVITE being acknowledged, but the CSeq method MUST be ACK.
actions: set ACK CSeq sequence number equal to INVITE CSeq sequence number

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The sequence number of the CSeq header field MUST be the same as the INVITE being acknowledged, but the CSeq method MUST be ACK.
actions: set ACK CSeq method to ACK

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The ACK MUST contain the same credentials as the INVITE.
actions: include same credentials in ACK as in INVITE

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If the 2xx contains an offer (based on the rules above), the ACK MUST carry an answer in its body.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the offer in the 2xx response is not acceptable, the UAC core MUST generate a valid answer in the ACK and then send a BYE immediately.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The ACK MUST be passed to the client transport every time a retransmission of the 2xx final response that triggered the ACK arrives.
actions: pass ACK to client transport on each retransmission of the 2xx final response that triggered the ACK

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If, after acknowledging any 2xx response to an INVITE, the UAC does not want to continue with that dialog, then the UAC MUST terminate the dialog by sending a BYE request as described in Section 15.
actions: terminate dialog by sending BYE request as described in Section 15
